final: WITH c AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), t AS (SELECT st, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS sh FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS avgsh FROM t) SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - (SELECT avgsh FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE sh > (SELECT avgsh FROM a)
